newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish investors pick mortgage bond for profit.
newsitem.headline: Danish investors pick mortgage bond for profit.

text.p: Danish institutional investors see local mortgage-backed bonds giving a better return over the next six months than Danish government or foreign bonds, a Danske Invest survey said on Tuesday.

The biannual survey of 51 decision-makers in the country's biggest insurance companies, pension funds, banks and industrial firms showed 50 percent of respondents selecting mortgage-backed paper compared to 36 percent in the last poll, six months ago.
Five percent voted for Danish government long bonds, 22 percent for 1-3 year treasuries and 23 percent for foreign paper, the poll showed.
Danske Invest is Denmark's largest investment society, handling over 15 billion crowns for 80,000 members.
Asked which shares, by geographical area, they saw as likely to be the most profitable 40 percent of panelists chose paper from elsewhere in Europe.

Nineteen percent opted for the far east excluding Japan, 17 percent for Japanese paper and 12 percent each for Denmark and the United States, the survey showed. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
